_provenance.local_operation: deterministic SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKK_SLH_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk), C_SignInit(CKM_SLH_DSA, CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT hedgeVariant = CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED, empty context), C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. Deterministic external/pure groups only: per parameter set, the 0-byte-context case with the shortest message (ties by lowest tcId), excluding tcIds already carried by slhdsa_ctx_test.json and slhdsa_siggen_det_test.json; a set whose group has no remaining 0-byte-context case is not carried (its empty-context case is already in slhdsa_siggen_det_test.json). Together with the 255-byte-context case of slhdsa_ctx_test.json this gives each parameter set both context-length extremes.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, hashAlg, sk, pk, message, context, signature (deferred and additionalRandomness dropped)
_provenance.test_only_key_material: sk values are public NIST ACVP-Server sample data, imported as session objects (CKA_TOKEN=false) and destroyed after the case
